name: Stealing Orgrimmar's Flame
label: Quest
description: Stealing Orgrimmar's Flame: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This flame, stolen from the heart of Orgrimmar itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...

clips.title: Progress
paras: You're practically glowing, traveler. What do you have there?

clips.title: Completion
paras: What's this? Unless I'm mistaken, this flame has been taken from the heart of Orgrimmar itself! The fierce hearts of the orcs and trolls are reflected in its searing heat. What a fine addition to our collection--how brave you are, stealing into the enemy's lair to retrieve the sacred flame!
